We analyzed 11 human cell lines using an LTQ-Orbitrap family mass spectrometer with a “high field” Orbitrap mass analyzer with improved resolution and sequencing speed.

Interestingly, we found four proteins that are encoded exclusively by Y chromosome genes, and the unique peptides of these proteins were expressed only in the cell lines of male origin (LnCap, Jurkat, HepG2, and A549).
